items.html: And the matter is that the Mochin of Bina were repaired and expanded by the power of the Yesod of Arich Anpin, which became a Neshama within it. And this Mochin expanded in the secret of the thirty-two Elokim that are in Bina, as is known. And it is, that the thirty-two paths are in Hochma, and when these thirty-two are in Bina, they become there thirty-two Elokim. It follows that these are the thirty-two paths of Hochma when they are in Bina, for then they are called thirty-two Elokim, because they are in Bina, which is called Elokim, as is known. And after its name it is called the thirty-two Elokim of the Act of Creation.
